annotations.text:
Design emails here in the website's real fonts + tokens.
Approved artboards get baked into Klaviyo as image-first emails — only the order ticket stays dynamic.
[COUPON] = placeholder, needs a real code.

One row per Klaviyo flow. The note at the left of each row names the flow and how it sends.

ABANDONED CART REMINDER
Standard (Email & SMS) · flow U62Fdc

Status: DRAFT — not sending yet.
Trigger: checkout started.
Sends at +4h → +24h → +44h.

SMS-consented profiles get the SMS instead of email 1, then rejoin for 2 and 3.

Wired 2026-09-15: the three messages now point at the "YM Theme - Abandoned Cart #1–3" templates (see the Previews page).

Email 3's send filter uses a hardcoded date (before 2026-06-04) — worth a second look.

THE OTHER NINE EMAILS
Built from the shared components with Rich's picked copy (2026-09-10 review deck) and pushed to Klaviyo 2026-09-15 — every flow is wired, all still DRAFT.

See the Previews page (pages menu) for the Klaviyo-rendered result of all 12.

An email becomes its own artboard row here when it needs design changes beyond copy.

PREVIEWS · rendered by Klaviyo 2026-09-15 with sample data (Rich, order #1042, two tees). One row per flow; the note at the left names the flow, its status and timing. All 12 templates live in Klaviyo as "YM Theme - …" (editor type: code — the repo is the source of truth). Every flow is still DRAFT: nothing sends until Rich turns a flow on in Klaviyo.

WELCOME SERIES
Klaviyo flow R6rGqF · DRAFT
Trigger: joins the Newsletter list.
#1 sends at once (new subscriber vs existing customer split) → #2 three days later at 11:00.

Wired 2026-09-15 to the YM Theme templates below. Welcome #1 new: 10% (Rich's note on the copy deck), code still [COUPON].

Trigger: checkout started. +4h → +24h → +44h. SMS-consented profiles get the SMS instead of email 1.

Copy approved on the Design page (Cart 1–3 artboards). Subject + preview lines are Rich's own. Cart 3 code still [COUPON].

BROWSE ABANDONMENT
Klaviyo flow UudsVq · DRAFT
Trigger: viewed a product, no add-to-cart. +1h → +1h.

Rich's note on browse #2 read "nioon" — unclear, ask.

REVIEW REQUEST
Klaviyo flow SNGPCE (email + SMS) · DRAFT — wired.
The older flow RWfGX9 "Review request" is LIVE on Klaviyo's default templates and was NOT touched: switch it off (or repoint it) when SNGPCE goes live, or both will send.

Request a few days after delivery → reminder 7 days later.
